nextjs-store-project.fullDescription:
NextJS Store is a full-stack web application designed to meet modern e-commerce needs.
Built with Next.js 13+ App Router, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit and MongoDB.

The project offers a comprehensive e-commerce solution with a user-friendly interface, powerful admin panel, secure payment system and real-time order tracking. It has a SEO-friendly and high-performance infrastructure with Server-side rendering (SSR) and static generation (SSG).

features.title: Advanced Cart System
features.desc: Global state managed with Redux, localStorage persistence and real-time cart updates.

features.title: Secure Payment
features.desc: Secure payment infrastructure with Stripe integration and multi-payment method support.

features.title: Order Tracking
features.desc: Real-time order status, shipping tracking and email notifications.

features.title: Product Management
features.desc: Detailed product filtering, category-based search and inventory management system.

features.title: Admin Panel
features.desc: Powerful admin panel for product CRUD operations, order management and user management.

features.title: Analytics & Reporting
features.desc: Sales analytics, user behavior tracking and detailed reporting features.

urun-talep-yonetim-sistemi.fullDescription: Users actively request products and these requests are managed by the admin, who can accept or reject them in real time. If a product doesn't exist, it cannot be requested, and if a product has already been requested, the same product cannot be requested again.

features.title: Real-Time Product/Request Management
features.desc: Request and manage products under multiple categories.

features.title: Filtering
features.desc: Easily find products and requests on each page with advanced filtering options.

features.title: Push Notifications
features.desc: Instant notifications when a product is requested and when status changes.

features.title: Secure Communication
features.desc: End-to-end encryption and JWT-based authentication.

Learning-Dashboard.fullDescription:
Learning Dashboard is an interactive application that helps users manage their learning processes. Users can add topics they've learned, track their progress, and set learning goals.
    Additionally, users can add topics they're stuck on and specify which part of the topic they're stuck on as a message.

features.title: Active, Stuck and Completed States
features.desc: Ability to track the user's learning process in three different states.

features.title: Tracking Stuck Topics
features.desc: Users can add topics they're stuck on and specify which part they're stuck on as a message.

features.title: Listing Learned Topics
features.desc: Users can write the topics they learned that day.

features.title: Filtering by Level and Status
features.desc: Users can filter their topics by level (easy, medium, hard) and status (active, stuck, completed).

features.title: Theme Toggle
features.desc: Users can switch the dashboard theme between light and dark mode.

dunya-ulkeleri-quiz-uygulamasi.fullDescription: An interactive quiz application that makes learning world countries fun. The user tries to guess any country on the world map and the geographical location of each country they type is shown on the map.

features.title: World Map Integration
features.desc: Finding countries on an interactive world map.

features.title: Time-Based Game Mode
features.desc: Finding as many countries as possible within a certain time.

features.title: Achievement Tracking
features.desc: Saving countries the user knows and their scores.

features.title: Zoom to Location
features.desc: Zooming in and out on the relevant country on the map.
